authority_boundary: HumanDecisionGate records architecture, source-grounding, and runtime-readiness dispositions after deterministic rule evaluation. It is not required scientific evidence and cannot change a RuleResult, compute an evidence-supported claim ceiling, or upgrade a Draft into an active runtime.

gates.legacy_id_note: The existing contract identifier is retained for Draft compatibility. This gate does not verify primary-source entailment.
